Name: Japhlet
Summary: Son of Heber and father of Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:32: Son of Heber and father of Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Japhlet stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
